product_metadata.title: Workmoto Foam Cannon for Power Washer, Electric Pressure Washer with 5 Universal Spray Nozzles and Detergent Tank, Pressure Cleaner - 5000PSI 4.0GPM
features: FOAM CANNON: Produces dense foam and stays on the surface longer for resulting in better cleaning performance. Compared to built-in detergent tank, foam cannon doesn't deliver foam through the pump to affect pump's life. So no worry to use various detergents and chemicals
